synopsis: Dark Droids (Omnibus Hardcover) is the Marvel Omnibus compilation of the entire Marvel Comics Dark Droids Series First, it comes for the metal…Horror grips the Star Wars galaxy as corruption spreads from one droid to the next, causing chaos for both the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire! Who or what is the Scourge - and why is no droid safe? What role does Ajax Sigma play in all of this? And whose side is he on? The complete Dark Droids saga is collected in one volume for the first time as the rebel crew, the Bounty Hunters, Doctor Aphra, Darth Vader and, of course, your favorite droids face terrible implications! To fight this menace, R2-D2 assembles his own team of heroes: the D-Squad! In the wake of this nightmare, another chapter of Marvel's Star Wars storytelling ends, setting the stage for Return of the Jedi!Collecting: Dark Droids (2023) #1-5 Dark Droids - D-Squad (2023) #1-4 Star Wars (2020) #37-50 Bounty Hunters (2020) #37-42 Darth Vader (2020) #37-50 Doctor Aphra (2020) #35-40 Revelations (2023) #1 Free Comic Book Day 2024 Star Wars (2024) #1
title: Dark Droids (Omnibus Hardcover)
